title: Cloudstitch · 적조의 왕관

source.method: original code-authored volumetric architecture and vertex painting

semantic_groups.description: 속이 빈 산호 나팔 포신과 가지 방벽

appearance.surfaces: Original coloured vertex painting plus one embedded 1024x1024 procedural hand-painted nacre/bone/coral/fibre atlas.
appearance.palette: pearl ivory and rose, red coral, indigo reef, cyan bioluminescence, warm amber cave windows
appearance.material: glTF metallic-roughness, roughness 1, metalness 0; review can replace with hand-painted unlit or toon shading
appearance.runtime: Outline and cel shading belong to review runtime; they are not automatically reproduced by importing the GLB into an engine.
appearance.textureSource: Deterministic canvas drawing, seed91843; no API image generation, no chapter-one textures.

limitations: Art review prototype only; no gameplay or enemy AI.
No authored collision, LOD, navmesh, engine sockets, gameplay statistics or destruction.
Static geometry; no rig or animation; the bone cranes, shell crown, textiles and coral cannons are modeled in a fixed pose.
Building interiors are not authored; open harbour is an exterior architectural cavity without playable interior.

storage.method: Exact bitwise duplicate-vertex indexing; no quantization, decimation or shape change. UVs exactly follow the frozen first-paint per-triangle formula; UV is part of each welding key. Material primitives remain separate.

orientation.scope: Only bell_tower group rigid transform changed: Y180 around x5.5/z-8.5. All other JSON and all binary bytes exact.
orientation.reason: Expose the spiral face toward the front harbour camera, following actual front/back render inspection.
